changes: FIFO user updates enter at safe boundaries, without cancelling or modifying the active decoder.
An unexecuted proposal is retained as superseded_action; its model context explicitly says it was not executed.
A pending approval is withdrawn with a negative resolution, never granted automatically. Any revised action retains its normal approval.
Completed tool result and pending correction are separate user-role messages in the next request; one generation per session.
Corrections preserve original action/repair/subtask limits, loaded explicit instructions, drafts, attachment identity and prompt hooks.
Insufficient context or oversized wire body preserves completed tool results; pending updates remain queued.

tests.steering: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: real HTTP streaming; correction before write prevents wrong.txt; revised write produces exactly correct.txt; correction during one actual shell command is delivered after TOOL_SENTINEL with one result and one command; correction during pending manual approval withdraws old proposal without executing it and requires new approval.
tests.hooks_and_limits: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: UserPromptSubmit gets original/update text exactly once each with the same turn_id; original explicit instructions retained in final generation snapshot; action counts remain 1 for before/during and 2 for a revised approval, not reset by steering.
tests.archive_and_context_failure: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: queued UUID/attachments delivered once, unsent draft retained, Codable roundtrip; insufficient context with auto-compact disabled retains exactly one completed tool result and leaves update paused.
tests.queue: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: full FIFO streaming/tool fixture, attachment and unsent-draft preservation, background session/unread, error/cancel pause and explicit resume, restored queues paused, safe editing.
tests.context: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: full context/plugin fixture suite, manual/auto compact at 99%, adaptive Unicode summaries, queue continuation, actual usage, archive preservation, failure/Stop rollback and tool-result conservation.
tests.continuation: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: ordinary recovery still reads one real file, bounded malformed-action and promise repairs, action limit and Stop; pending user update precedes automatic repair with no unwanted action; no guessed execution or length-truncation repair; raw tool wrappers hidden and normal-stop outer-brace tolerance preserved.
tests.localization: PASS Intel/native M1 Ultra: EN default/legacy migration, IT persistence, catalog interpolation/placeholders and shell prerequisites.
tests.identity: PASS: 1.4.9.05 build 46 release identity, migration guards and retained Apple Events declaration/entitlement signing paths.
tests.installer: PASS: extracted 1.4.9.05 build 46, Universal app/command/terminal helpers and arm64 engine; deep/strict ad-hoc signature, app automation entitlement, Apple Events description in IT/EN, both HTML guides and release notes, unchanged engine content/helper hashes.

limits: Synthetic localhost model fixtures and temporary workspaces; no execution of user session commands, installed-app replacement or live archive modifications.
The active decode cannot receive new input tokens. Updates are submitted in the next request, not spliced into an in-flight stream. Already started operations continue unless explicitly stopped.
Server-side inference speed, cache behavior and real-model interpretation of a correction are not qualified by these fixture tests. No new GPU/performance/KL claims.
Paused, stopped or restored queues require explicit resume. Corrections within a work cycle cannot bypass configured action/repair/subtask limits.
Runtime-only MCP jobs and best-effort cancellation retain the scope qualified in RELEASE_1.4.9.04_QA.json; no change to the transport implementation.
